# Technical QC Instructions

- Audio QC: intelligible dialogue, no clipping, mutes, doubled audio, sync
  drift, pops, abrupt room-tone changes, or music/SFX masking speech.
- Visual QC: no offline media, broken effects, missing fonts, black frames,
  flash frames, accidental freeze frames, unintended crop/stretch, or unreadable
  UI/product/gameplay details.
- Caption QC: captions match final master, terms/names are correct, timing is
  readable, speakers are clear when needed, and captions do not expose redacted
  private information.
- Export QC: verify frame rate, resolution, aspect ratio, progressive scan,
  square pixels, codec/container, audio sample rate, channel mapping, and no
  unnecessary re-encoding generations.
- Use current YouTube upload documentation before final delivery. Standard
  YouTube masters normally use 48 kHz audio.
- Watch or inspect the full master with an approved QC method. Confirm clean
  start/end, thumbnail candidates, chapters/captions from the approved master,
  and end-screen-safe space when required.
